cashFlow.title: Cash flow and reminders
cashFlow.subtitle: What comes in, what must go out, and the lowest balance ahead.

kpi.setMin: Set a minimum balance on Settings

chart.title: Money in and out each month · FY {{fy}}
chart.table: Money in and out by month
chart.emptyTitle: No money moved in this year yet
chart.emptyBody: Receipts, payments and bank entries appear here as they are posted.
chart.note: Moves between the company's own cash and bank accounts are left out of money in and out.

weeks.title: Next {{n}} weeks
weeks.body: Each week: open customer bills and supplier bills falling due (overdue ones count in this week). Salaries, EMIs and statutory dues join the forecast once their schedules are set.
weeks.caption: Amounts due by week

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.channels: WhatsApp, email and in the app
reminders.note: Reminders go out once the WhatsApp Business account and its sender are connected; Admin changes the schedule on WhatsApp & email.

buyer.when: 7 and 3 days before, on the day, then 3, 7 and 14 days late
buyer.to: Buyer (WhatsApp, email), then their sales person
buyer.then: Long overdue: the owner is told and new orders need Admin release

supplier.then: Goes into the payment run for Admin to approve

msme.when: Within the agreed period, at most 45 days
msme.then: Paid first in the payment run

salaries.then: Large advance cuts flagged before approval

statutory.when: TDS, GSTR-1, PF/ESI and GSTR-3B due dates
statutory.then: Amount due shown from locked books

emi.when: A few days before each date
emi.then: Warns if the balance will not cover it

low.when: When any forecast week falls below the minimum
low.then: Shows which payments to move or receipts to chase
